title: The Billings Settled Now at Each Stage of a Retrofit Project
content:
# The Billings Settled Now at Each Stage of a Retrofit Project

Which billings on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects an owner settles now depends on how far the project has gone, because a billing not yet due is left to its own term while work is still running.

## Rule

Where the project stands substantially complete and has not been closed out, only the billings whose due day has passed are settled now, a billing not yet due being left to its own term.

Where the project has not reached substantial completion and has not been closed out, only the progress billings whose due day has passed are settled now.

Where the project has been closed out, every billing raised on it is settled now, whether or not its due day has passed.

## Which billings have a due day that has passed

A billing whose due day has passed is one whose due day falls no later than the day of settlement and no earlier than five years before it, five years being 60 months and as far back as a project account runs.

| Status of the project | Billings settled now |
|---|---|
| substantially complete | the deposit, mobilisation, progress, change order and remobilisation billings whose due day has passed |
| estimated, awarded, scheduled or in progress | the progress billings whose due day has passed |
| closed | every deposit, mobilisation, progress, change order and remobilisation billing raised, due or not |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A project holds a deposit billing due two months ago, progress billings due last month of USD 60000, a change order billing falling due next month of USD 9000 and a remobilisation fee due last week. Standing substantially complete, everything but the change order billing is settled now. Standing in progress, only the USD 60000 of progress billings is settled now. Once closed out, the change order billing joins the rest and all of it is settled now.
